job.title: Permanent Registered Nurse – Aged Care
job.description:
About BLU Healthcare

BLU Healthcare is a leading healthcare recruitment agency supporting aged care facilities, hospitals, NDIS providers and community care services across Australia. We connect healthcare professionals with rewarding career opportunities where they can make a meaningful difference.

We are currently seeking a Registered Nurse (RN) for a permanent opportunity at a community-based residential aged care facility in Gayndah, Queensland.

This is an excellent opportunity for nurses looking to build their careers in regional Queensland, with relocation assistance and potential visa sponsorship opportunities for eligible candidates.

About the Facility

Our client operates a 52-bed residential aged care facility providing quality care and support to older Australians within a welcoming regional community.

Gayndah offers a relaxed lifestyle, a close-knit community and access to several regional centres.

Approximate travel times:

  • Brisbane: 3.5–4 hours

  • Sunshine Coast: 2.5 hours

  • Hervey Bay: Under 2 hours

  • Gympie, Bundaberg and Kingaroy: Approximately 2 hours

Position Details

  • Position: Registered Nurse

  • Location: Gayndah, Queensland

  • Employment Type: Permanent

  • Salary: $42.13–$56.00 per hour, plus applicable penalties, depending on experience and years of service

  • Start Date: Immediate start available

Key Responsibilities

As a Registered Nurse, you will be responsible for delivering safe, compassionate and person-centred care to residents. Your duties will include:

  • Providing high-quality nursing care tailored to residents’ individual needs.

  • Administering medications and monitoring residents’ health and wellbeing.

  • Developing, implementing and reviewing individualised care plans.

  • Supervising and supporting care staff to maintain high standards of care.

  • Maintaining accurate clinical records and documentation.

  • Communicating effectively with residents, families and other healthcare professionals.

  • Ensuring compliance with relevant Aged Care Quality Standards and clinical policies.

  • Participating in quality improvement initiatives and ongoing clinical reviews.

  • Recognising and responding promptly to changes in residents’ conditions and medical emergencies.

  • Maintaining professional knowledge and participating in continuing professional development.

What’s on Offer?

  • Permanent Employment: Secure a rewarding nursing position within a regional residential aged care setting.
  • Relocation Assistance: Eligible candidates may receive up to $10,000 in relocation or remote-area benefits, subject to the employer’s eligibility criteria and applicable conditions.
  • Visa Sponsorship Opportunities: Sponsorship support may be available for eligible candidates already residing in Australia, including potential Subclass 407 or 485-related pathways, subject to individual eligibility and applicable immigration requirements.
  • Salary Packaging: Access salary packaging benefits through a not-for-profit employer, potentially up to $18,549 per year, subject to eligibility and applicable rules.
  • Generous Annual Leave: Five weeks of annual leave, with the option to purchase additional leave, subject to the employer’s policies.
  • Regional Lifestyle: Enjoy a relaxed pace of life and the opportunity to become part of a welcoming regional community.

Essential Requirements

To be considered for this opportunity, you must have:

  • Current registration with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) as a Registered Nurse.

  • A minimum of six months’ experience working as an RN in an aged care setting.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Knowledge of AN-ACC funding and the Aged Care Quality Standards.

  • Intermediate computer skills and confidence with clinical documentation systems.

  • A valid NDIS Worker Screening clearance, as required for the role.

  • A current National Police Check, in accordance with the employer’s requirements.

  • A valid Queensland driver’s licence.

How to Apply

If you are a Registered Nurse seeking a permanent opportunity in regional Queensland, we would love to hear from you.

Whether you are looking for a fresh start, considering relocation or exploring eligible sponsorship pathways, this could be the next step in your nursing career.

job.title: Casual Disability Support Workers
job.description:
Disability Support Worker – Casual | NSW SIL

Blu Healthcare is a leading healthcare recruitment agency supporting NDIS providers, aged care facilities, community care services, disability organisations, and hospitals across Australia.

We are currently seeking experienced Disability Support Workers for casual shift opportunities across Goonellabah, Myocum, Lismore, Banora Point, Tweed Heads South, and Ocean Shores, NSW.

We are looking for reliable, compassionate workers with strong SIL experience and hands-on experience supporting participants with complex care needs.

About the Role

As a Disability Support Worker, you will provide high-quality, person-centred support to participants living in Supported Independent Living (SIL) homes.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Assisting participants with personal care and daily living activities.

  • Medication administration and management.

  • Manual handling and mobility assistance.

  • Domestic assistance and meal preparation.

  • Supporting participants with behaviours of concern in line with Positive Behaviour Support Plans (PBSPs).

  • Encouraging participation in community, social, and recreational activities.

  • Providing support in one-on-one and shared living environments.

  • Transporting participants using a company vehicle or your own registered and comprehensively insured vehicle.

Mandatory Complex Care Experience

Applicants must have hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • Diabetes management.

  • Dysphagia support.

  • Epilepsy and seizure management.

  • Complex bowel care.

Please apply only if you have experience supporting participants with these complex care needs.

About You

To be successful in this role, you must have:

  • Certificate III or IV in Individual Support (Disability, Ageing, or equivalent).

  • Previous experience working in Supported Independent Living (SIL) or complex disability support.

  • Current driver's licence.

  • Reliable, registered, and comprehensively insured vehicle.

  • Current Blue Card.

  • Current NDIS Worker Screening Check.

  • Current National Police Check.

  • Current First Aid and CPR certificates.

  • Completed NDIS Worker Orientation Module – Quality, Safety and You.

  • Full Australian working rights.

  • A genuine passion for supporting people with disability to achieve their goals and live as independently as possible.

Strong communication skills, reliability, and the ability to work confidently in complex care environments are essential.

What We Offer

  • Competitive hourly pay rates.

  • Flexible casual shifts, including morning, afternoon, overnight, sleepover, and weekend shifts.

  • A user-friendly mobile app to view, manage, and accept shifts.

  • Kilometre reimbursement for approved community access shifts.

  • Ongoing support from a dedicated recruitment and rostering team.

  • Opportunities to gain experience across a range of disability support settings.

Apply Today!

If you have the required complex care experience and are passionate about making a positive difference in the lives of people living with disability, we would love to hear from you.

Expression of Interest – Casual Registered Nurses (General Medical & General Surgical)

Flexible Casual Agency Shifts Across Leading Sunshine Coast Hospitals

BLU Healthcare is currently seeking experienced and passionate Registered Nurses with General Medical and General Surgical experience to join our growing casual workforce across the Sunshine Coast region.

We are looking for nurses with recent hospital experience who are seeking flexible agency work across leading hospitals throughout the Sunshine Coast. This is an excellent opportunity to enjoy flexibility, variety, and competitive agency pay rates while expanding your clinical experience in a range of healthcare settings.

About the Role

As a Casual Registered Nurse with BLU Healthcare, you will have the flexibility to choose shifts that suit your lifestyle while delivering high-quality patient care across General Medical and General Surgical wards.

What We Offer

  • Flexible casual shifts – work when it suits you
  • Competitive agency pay rates
  • Opportunities across leading Sunshine Coast hospitals
  • Variety of clinical environments
  • Supportive and responsive allocations team
  • Weekly pay
  • Ongoing opportunities for experienced nurses

Essential Requirements

  • Current AHPRA registration as a Registered Nurse
  • Minimum 1+ year recent experience in General Medical and/or General Surgical hospital wards
  • Excellent communication and clinical skills
  • Current National Police Check (or willingness to obtain)
  • Yellow Card
  • Full Australian working rights
  • Current vaccination evidence in line with facility requirements

We're Looking for Nurses Who Are:

  • Reliable and adaptable
  • Patient-focused with strong clinical judgement
  • Able to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality patient care

If you're looking for flexibility, excellent support, and the opportunity to work across a variety of Sunshine Coast healthcare facilities, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply Now

Join BLU Healthcare and take control of your nursing career with flexible casual agency opportunities across the Sunshine Coast.

job.title: Casual Disability Support Workers
job.description:
Disability Support Worker – Casual | GC SIL

Blu Healthcare is a leading healthcare recruitment agency proudly supporting NDIS providers, aged care facilities, community care services, disability organisations, and hospitals across Australia.

We are currently seeking experienced Disability Support Workers for casual shift opportunities across our client SIL based in Gold Coast suburbs like Pimpama and Hope Island.

About the Role

As a Disability Support Worker, you will provide high-quality, person-centred support to participants living in Supported Independent Living (SIL) homes.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Assisting participants with personal care and daily living activities
  • Medication administration
  • Manual handling and mobility assistance
  • Domestic assistance and meal preparation
  • Supporting participants with behaviours of concern in line with Positive Behaviour Support Plans (PBSPs)
  • Encouraging participation in community, social and recreational activities
  • Providing support in both one-on-one and shared living environments
  • Transporting participants using a company vehicle or your own registered and comprehensively insured vehicle
  • Providing specialised support to participants with complex care needs

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Certificate III or IV in Individual Support (Disability, Ageing or equivalent)
  • Previous experience working in SIL, community disability support or complex care
  • Current Driver’s Licence
  • Reliable, registered and comprehensively insured vehicle
  • Current NDIS Worker Screening Check
  • Current National Police Check
  • Current First Aid and CPR Certificate
  • Completion of the NDIS Worker Orientation Module – Quality, Safety and You
  • Full Australian working rights
  • A genuine passion for supporting people with disability to achieve their goals and live independently


Experience or competency in the following areas is required:

  • Complex Wound Care
  • Asthma Awareness
  • Dysphagia Support
  • Diabetes Management
  • Hoist transfers
  • Medication Administration
  • Mealtime Management
  • Seizure Managemnt

What We Offer:

  • Competitive hourly pay rates
  • Flexible casual shifts, including morning, afternoon, overnight, sleepover and weekend shifts
  • User-friendly mobile app to view, manage and accept shifts
  • Kilometre reimbursement for approved community access shifts
  • Ongoing support from a dedicated recruitment and rostering team
  • Opportunities to gain experience across a range of disability support settings

If you are passionate about making a positive difference in the lives of people living with disability, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today and join the Blu Healthcare team!
